DD has credible advanced IC-substrate materials exposure through interconnect, dry film photoresist, and copper chemistry, but corporate-separation and segment-mix verification are required.

The most direct ABF film and copper-adhesion chokepoints appear to be non-US or not cleanly investable as US-listed small/mid-cap equities; US-listed mapping is mostly through adjacent chemistry, materials handling, and inspection/metrology suppliers.

summary: Expanded the US-listed universe one layer below obvious AI accelerator and HBM names, focusing on substrate yield, build-up / dielectric-adjacent materials, copper plating / surface chemistry, contamination control, and inspection/metrology. The cleanest underfollowed US-listed mappings are not finished ABF substrate makers, but process-chemistry, materials-handling, and yield-control suppliers. Direct ABF film and copper-adhesion leaders cited in the search context, Ajinomoto and MEC, are important reference chokepoints but are not clean US-listed small/mid-cap AI infrastructure equities.
